notes.title: Expansion of a new area - the Underground Temple- and a comprehensive update.
notes.notes:
We have completed a large-scale update and unlocked a new area, which will make the game even more thrilling for players. This new area introduces powerful bosses and exciting battles to conquer.

Furthermore, we have taken into account the valuable feedback from our players and put in a lot of effort to address the issues within the game. As a result, we have focused on improving the gameplay experience, implementing many fixes and enhancements.

We invite you to step into the new area, face the new bosses, and obtain new items for your character. Don't miss out on the adventure that awaits you!
